## Feature Description

Describe the feature you would like to see implemented. You should talk about the problem it solves, the benefits it
brings and any potential caveats.

## Proposed Solution

Use this space to outline the technical details of your proposal. You can include code snippets, diagrams, written
explanations or anything else that you think will help in developing the feature.

## Willingness to Contribute

Remember to check the [Contributing guidelines](/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance on how to contribute.

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I can provide additional information if needed
